name: voice-router-dev
description: Universal speech-to-text router for Gladia, AssemblyAI, Deepgram, Azure, OpenAI Whisper, Speechmatics, Soniox, and ElevenLabs

scripts.build:all: pnpm build:types && pnpm build:bundle && pnpm build:docs
scripts.build:types: echo '📦 Generating TypeScript types from OpenAPI specs...' && pnpm openapi:generate
scripts.openapi:sync: echo '🔄 Syncing OpenAPI specs from remote sources...' && node scripts/sync-specs.js
scripts.openapi:sync:speechmatics: node scripts/sync-specs.js --provider speechmatics && node scripts/sync-specs.js --provider speechmaticsAsync
scripts.openapi:sync:soniox: node scripts/sync-specs.js --provider soniox && node scripts/sync-specs.js --provider sonioxModels
scripts.openapi:fix-specs: node scripts/fix-openai-spec.js && node scripts/fix-speechmatics-spec.js && node scripts/fix-deepgram-spec.js && node scripts/fix-elevenlabs-spec.js && node scripts/fix-assemblyai-spec.js && node scripts/fix-azure-spec.js
scripts.openapi:generate: pnpm openapi:fix-specs && pnpm openapi:record-consumed && pnpm openapi:clean && orval && pnpm openapi:sync-assemblyai-streaming && pnpm openapi:sync-deepgram-streaming && pnpm openapi:sync-deepgram-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-deepgram-models && pnpm openapi:sync-speechmatics-streaming && pnpm openapi:sync-speechmatics-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-soniox-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-soniox-models && pnpm openapi:sync-soniox-streaming && pnpm openapi:sync-openai-models && pnpm openapi:sync-azure-locales && pnpm openapi:sync-elevenlabs-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-elevenlabs-models && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata
scripts.openapi:generate:gladia: pnpm openapi:clean:gladia && orval --config orval.config.ts --project gladiaApi && orval --config orval.config.ts --project gladiaZod && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata
scripts.openapi:generate:assemblyai: node scripts/fix-assemblyai-spec.js && pnpm openapi:clean:assemblyai && orval --config orval.config.ts --project assemblyaiApi && orval --config orval.config.ts --project assemblyaiZod && pnpm openapi:sync-assemblyai-streaming && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata
scripts.openapi:generate:deepgram: pnpm openapi:clean:deepgram && orval --config orval.config.ts --project deepgramApi && orval --config orval.config.ts --project deepgramZod && pnpm openapi:sync-deepgram-streaming && pnpm openapi:sync-deepgram-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-deepgram-models && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata
scripts.openapi:generate:azure: node scripts/fix-azure-spec.js && pnpm openapi:clean:azure && orval --config orval.config.ts --project azureSTTApi && orval --config orval.config.ts --project azureSTTZod && pnpm openapi:sync-azure-locales && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata
scripts.openapi:generate:openai: node scripts/fix-openai-spec.js && pnpm openapi:clean:openai && orval --config orval.config.ts --project openaiWhisperApi && orval --config orval.config.ts --project openaiWhisperZod && pnpm openapi:sync-openai-models && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata
scripts.openapi:generate:speechmatics: node scripts/fix-speechmatics-spec.js && pnpm openapi:clean:speechmatics && orval --config orval.config.ts --project speechmaticsApi && orval --config orval.config.ts --project speechmaticsZod && pnpm openapi:sync-speechmatics-streaming && pnpm openapi:sync-speechmatics-languages && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata
scripts.openapi:generate:soniox: pnpm openapi:clean:soniox && orval --config orval.config.ts --project sonioxApi && orval --config orval.config.ts --project sonioxZod && pnpm openapi:sync-soniox-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-soniox-models && pnpm openapi:sync-soniox-streaming && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata
scripts.openapi:generate:elevenlabs: node scripts/fix-elevenlabs-spec.js && pnpm openapi:clean:elevenlabs && orval --config orval.config.ts --project elevenlabsApi && orval --config orval.config.ts --project elevenlabsZod && pnpm openapi:sync-elevenlabs-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-elevenlabs-models && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata
scripts.openapi:generate:csharp:gladia: pnpm openapi:fix:csharp:gladia && pnpm openapi:clean:csharp:gladia && openapi-generator-cli generate -i specs/gladia-openapi-csharp.json -g csharp -o ./generated-csharp/gladia --additional-properties=packageName=Gladia.SDK,targetFramework=net8.0,nullableReferenceTypes=true
scripts.openapi:rebuild: pnpm openapi:sync && pnpm openapi:generate && pnpm build
scripts.docs:generate: pnpm docs:clean && pnpm docs:prepare-generated && pnpm docs:generate:router && pnpm docs:generate:webhooks && pnpm docs:generate:gladia && pnpm docs:generate:assemblyai && pnpm docs:generate:deepgram && pnpm docs:generate:azure && pnpm docs:generate:openai && pnpm docs:generate:speechmatics && pnpm docs:generate:soniox && pnpm docs:generate:elevenlabs && pnpm docs:field-equivalences:raw
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm openapi:sync && pnpm openapi:generate && pnpm openapi:check-generated && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test:entrypoints
scripts.prebuild: pnpm openapi:fix-specs && pnpm openapi:fix && pnpm openapi:sync-soniox-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-soniox-models && pnpm openapi:sync-speechmatics-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-azure-locales && pnpm openapi:sync-deepgram-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-deepgram-models && pnpm openapi:sync-openai-models && pnpm openapi:sync-elevenlabs-languages && pnpm openapi:sync-elevenlabs-models && pnpm openapi:refresh-public-metadata

author: Lazare Zemliak <lazare@meetingbaas.com>
